svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-a-coat-nametag-officer-nco","name":"Men's Class A coat nametag, officer/nco (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-a-coat; name left blank)","size_in":{"w":23.726,"h":29.955},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2372.6,2995.5],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Metal officer/NCO tag drawn at the same 3 3/8 x 3/4 in as the cadet plate (cross-chat standard plate size); the regulation gives no dimension and no vendor plate was cited for 3.0 x 0.7 in.","anchors":{"top_center":[1186.3,0],"bottom_center":[1186.3,2995.5],"center":[1186.3,1497.75],"left_edge":[0,1497.75],"right_edge":[2372.6,1497.75],"nametag_center":[764.45,1041.5]},"landmarks":{"nametag":{"x":595.7,"y":1004,"w":337.5,"h":75}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)","overlay_of":"garment-blues-class-a-coat","documented":["Officer/NCO nametag (CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2.2.2.1: metal, brushed satin silver, last name engraved in blue)","centred on the wearer's right between the sleeve seam and lapel, bottom parallel with the ground and even with the bottom of the ribbons (4.1.5.2.2.2)"],"assumed":["plate size","name line blank"],"fit":{"method":"original","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
